decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, 100, 101, and 102 received: 04/10/2017. 200 Rev 05 and 300 Rev 04 received: 14/11/2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building. This includes the cladding of the external walls of the roof extension in hung tiles.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of rear roof extension to the house with one front roof window
